Issues at the Cyberville’s Water Treatment Plant...

Incident Description; Cyberville has a water treatment plant like many others around the country. Lately, some citizens have noticed issues with the taste of the drinking water. On certain days, it tastes different, and other times, it even has an unpleasant smell. To keep the water safe, 🧪Chlorine and 🧪Fluoride are added automatically. Getting the right amount is really important because too much or too little could be harmful. We use two remote-control machines, managed by a b.Board, to carefully add these chemicals. Every week, after water tests are done, we adjust the levels based on a scale from 0 to 10. 🧪Chlorine is monitored by a blue BLiXel, and 🧪Fluoride by a green BLiXel. These BLiXels are part of a single strip on the control machine operated by the b.Board.
